description: International Network of AI Safety Institutes launched with ten founding members and the US institute as inaugural chair. The date is that of the US fact sheet; the members' mission statement says they gathered in San Francisco on 21 November 2024 to launch the network.
short: International Network of AI Safety Institutes launches with ten founding members.

description: Inaugural two-day technical meeting in San Francisco on 20–21 November.
short: Inaugural technical meeting held over two days in San Francisco.

description: Published pilot testing of Llama 3.1 405B by the US, UK and Singapore institutes, conducted during October and November.
short: US, UK and Singapore pilot testing of Llama 3.1 405B is published.

description: The full report of the multilingual joint testing exercise is listed by Singapore AI Safety Institute on 26 June 2025. It follows the February summary and names the participating institutes and government-mandated offices.
short: Full multilingual evaluation report publicly listed, with named institute contributions.

description: Third joint testing exercise publishes agentic evaluation methods and results. The UK-led cybersecurity strand included participants from the UK, EU AI Office and Australia.
short: Third joint testing exercise publishes agentic evaluation methods and results.

description: Network members convened in Vancouver; the third joint testing results accompanied the meeting.
short: Network meets in Vancouver alongside third joint testing results.

description: Members met in San Diego alongside NeurIPS to discuss automated AI evaluation practices.
short: Members meet in San Diego alongside NeurIPS to discuss automated evaluations.

description: Renamed the International Network for Advanced AI Measurement, Evaluation and Science; the UK took on the Network Coordinator role. The announcement was published on 9 December after the meeting.
short: Network renamed International Network for Advanced AI Measurement, Evaluation and Science.

description: The network's multilingual joint-testing summary was publicly listed on 10 February 2025. The full report's first retrieved public listing followed on 18 July.
short: Multilingual joint-testing summary published before the detailed report.
